_source: Every pad on this board was written for this board. The noises are SYNTHESISED IN THE BROWSER -- oscillators, filters and a buffer of white noise, built inside the click handler -- so the Playhouse's house rule stays true: nothing is fetched, and the room is silent until somebody presses something. The 'heard' line on each pad is not decoration and is not a caption for the drawing: it is the noise said in words, into the room's live region, so that a board made of sounds is not a board you have to be able to hear.
_moods: THE BOTTOM ROW IS NOT A FEELINGS CHART. Three pads with three moods each, and what changes is the shape of a NOISE -- a hum that glides up, a hum that sags, a hum with a buzz in it. Nobody is being asked to identify an emotion, match a face, or perform one, which is why there are no faces anywhere on this board: a happy/sad/angry face row on a Disabled people's site is the emotion flashcard, and we are not building one of those by accident. A sad noise is a perfectly good thing to want, and the room says so out loud rather than treating the bottom row as the one you are supposed to press your way out of.
_cycle: A mood pad SHOWS THE MOOD IT WILL PLAY and moves on to the next one after it has played it, so the face of the button is always a description of what pressing it does. The flourish belongs to the noise that just happened; the label belongs to the one that has not.

pads.name: CLICK
pads.what: A pen, clicked once. Then again. Then eleven more times, because that is what the pen is for.
pads.heard: one dry tick, over almost before it started

pads.name: POP
pads.what: One bubble off a sheet of bubble wrap. There is no sheet and it never runs out.
pads.heard: a small round bloop, bending upwards as it goes

pads.name: RAIN
pads.what: A rainstick tipped over and set back down. Nothing in it is in a hurry.
pads.heard: a long soft hiss that swells in the middle and thins out

pads.name: CHIME
pads.what: One tine, struck once and left alone. The point is the part after the hit.
pads.heard: a bell struck once and left to ring itself out

pads.name: PURR
pads.what: A low rumble with a trill in it. Cat-adjacent, legally distinct.
pads.heard: a low rumble, trilling about twenty times a second

pads.name: SQUEAK
pads.what: A thumb dragged across a balloon. Some people love this one and some people are already scrolling.
pads.heard: a short high squeal that slides up and drops

pads.name: THE HUM
pads.what: A voice with the mouth shut. Three moods, taken in turns.

moods.heard: an even drone that lifts a third and stays up there
the same drone, slower, sagging a tone and a half as it goes
two drones a hair apart, buzzing against each other, flat the whole way

pads.name: THE SPRING
pads.what: A doorstop, flicked. Three moods, taken in turns.

moods.heard: a boing that climbs and wobbles itself out at the top
a long slack boing, falling the whole way down
a hard twang, rattling against something on the way down

pads.name: THE DRUM
pads.what: One hand on one drum. Three moods, taken in turns.

moods.heard: three light hits, each one higher than the last
one soft low hit with a long tail on it
one hard hit with a crack of noise across the front of it
